title: custom:rain-card-pro
description: The rain rate as a tile, a flow tile or a hero, with falling drops, ripples or a filling gauge that rules colour.

today.description: Today's total (mm, in): fills the gauge and shows as "… today"

wind.description: Wind speed sensor: slants the drops

direction.description: Wind direction sensor (degrees or a compass point): which way the drops slant

name.description: The name (default: the sensor's friendly name). Template allowed.

secondary.description: Replaces the line under the name (default: rate · total today, or label · total today). Template allowed.

icon_style.description: The icon lead (lead: icon) in its soft circle, or plain: the icon alone; the animated lead keeps its circle

rules.description: On the rate (below / above): colour of the rain and the lead, label and tint; first match wins

layout.description: tile; hero: the big value above a band; poster: the entity card's poster, the icon and the label's pill on top, the big value at the bottom

visual.description: tile and poster: `flow` makes the whole tile or poster the animated field

lead.description: The round lead: a small animation of the style, or the rain icon (a flow tile or poster always shows the icon)

height.description: Height of the hero's flow band (px)

title_tap_action.description: Action when the title or its icon is tapped, e.g. navigate to the room's dashboard (default: none)
